dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: If we were in Liyue Harbor, this street would be crammed with people... and I don't think I'd stay longer than I needed to.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: But here, this street seems like such a safe place...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Join me for a walk. It could be good practice for you, helping me acclimatize to the mortal world.
